title: 第1922章 你的新身份 璐王他爹第1921章 二选一选女人还是选儿子
content_zh:
谢长陵真是狡猾啊，故意将难题抛给他。
陈观楼琢磨了一会，干脆问道：“皇帝有多厌恶璐王妃宋安许母女？”
如何抉择，有时候不能完全取决于他的意愿。要考虑到后续影响！元鼎帝在位一天，威胁就存在。
元鼎帝的态度，必须考虑进去。
“非常厌恶！尤其是对璐王妃，极为不满。”谢长陵没有夸大其词，“璐王妃害了璐王生不出儿子，还将王府其余庶出子统统弄死，已经犯了忌讳。陛下非常重视规矩礼法。璐王妃的做法，在陛下看来，是对礼法的挑衅。是宗亲祸乱的根源。先帝纵容，是因为先帝顾念情义！陛下则是要拨乱反正。”
陈观楼闻言，不由得皱起眉头，“照你这么说，如果宋安许继承爵位，皇帝纵然捏着鼻子答应下来，后续也会找茬。”
“当然。”谢长陵端起茶杯抿了一口，“陛下眼里容不下沙子，尤其是挑战他底线的事情。”
“皇帝却容忍了你。”陈观楼没忍住，怼了一句。
“也因此，老夫的处境岌岌可危。”谢长陵没有否认，甚至坦诚自己的处境不太妙。“当然，宋安许可以效仿老夫，只要她能承受陛下的千般手段。她要是能做到，老夫倒是佩服她的勇气。不是谁都能轻易承受陛下的怒火。”
陈观楼点点头，表示赞同。
元鼎帝的脾气，这么多年该了解的都已经了解，不是个能容人的。
璐王妃宋安许这对母女，着实是开了先河，犯了很多忌讳。有人夸她们，敢想敢干。更多的人则是唾骂她们，祸乱朝纲，败坏礼法！堪称宗亲里面的反面教材，比造反还要罪大恶极。
只因为先帝点头同意，临死之前又给了旨意，众人才无可奈何捏着鼻子认了此事。
如今，皇帝的态度耐人寻味，似乎是要拨乱反正。
这让某些人蠢蠢欲动。
试图搅风搅雨，插手璐王府的王位继承。
说不定这会已经有人在联系璐王一脉宗亲，试图推翻这对母女。
宋安许继承王位之路，当真是步步荆棘。
“那就按照王府的意思，让大公子宋成霖继承王爵。”
陈观楼想通了。

不能给王府招灾惹祸，顺利继承王爵比什么都重要。至于宋安许，想必也能理解。谁让建始帝死得太早。
但凡建始帝活到现在，宋安许继承王爵不会有任何掣肘。皇位也落不到元鼎帝头上，静妃说不定有机会染指太后宝座。
“确定吗？”谢长陵含笑问道。
陈观楼重重点头，“确定！只要爵位在他们一家人手里捏着，旁的事情都可以妥协。”
谢长陵轻声一笑，“你的决定很明智，没有试图跟陛下对着干。陛下奈何不了老夫，未必奈何不了璐王府。老夫会替你在陛下面前，为宋安许求一份体面。无法继承爵位，该有的身份还是要有。”
“给什么身份？”陈观楼随口问道。失去了王爵，其他任何身份，想来都不能让宋安许满意。
“郡主身份如何？”
“她原本就是郡主。后来得了世子女的身份，人们才淡忘了她的郡主身份。”
“朝廷能给的只有这个，你要是不稀罕就算了。”谢长陵冷笑一声。
content_en:
Xie Changling was really cunning, deliberately throwing difficult problems to him.
Chen Guanlou thought for a while and simply asked: "How much does the emperor hate Princess Lu, Song Anxu and her daughter?"
How to choose sometimes cannot completely depend on his wishes. Consider the subsequent effects! As long as Emperor Yuanding reigns, threats will exist.
Emperor Yuanding's attitude must be taken into consideration.
"Very disgusted! Especially for Princess Lu, I am extremely dissatisfied." Xie Changling did not exaggerate, "Princess Lu caused Prince Lu to be unable to have a son, and also killed all the sons of the other concubines in the palace. This has already violated a taboo. Your Majesty. Your Majesty attaches great importance to rules and etiquette. In Your Majesty's opinion, Princess Lu's behavior is a provocation to the etiquette and is the source of the chaos in the clan. The reason why the late Emperor cares about friendship is to bring order to things."
When Chen Guanlou heard this, he couldn't help but frowned, "According to what you said, if Song Anxu inherits the title, even if the emperor holds his nose and agrees, he will find trouble later."
"Of course." Xie Changling picked up the tea cup and took a sip, "His Majesty can't tolerate sand in his eyes, especially things that challenge his bottom line."
"The emperor tolerated you." Chen Guanlou couldn't hold it back and retorted.
"Because of this, I am in a precarious situation." Xie Changling did not deny it, and even admitted that his situation was not good. "Of course, Song An can follow my example, as long as she can withstand His Majesty's various methods. If she can do it, I would admire her courage. Not everyone can easily bear His Majesty's wrath."
Chen Guanlou nodded in agreement.
Emperor Yuanding's temper has been known to everyone for so many years, and he is not tolerant.
The mother and daughter, Princess Lu, Song Anxu, really set a precedent and committed many taboos. Some people praise them for daring to think and do what they do. More people scolded them, bringing trouble to the court and corrupting etiquette! It can be called a negative teaching material in the clan, and it is more sinful than rebellion.
Just because the late emperor nodded in agreement and gave the decree before his death, everyone reluctantly admitted the matter with their noses pinched.
Now, the emperor's attitude is intriguing, and he seems to be trying to bring order to the chaos.
This makes some people want to take action.
Trying to stir up trouble and interfere with the succession of the throne of Prince Lu's palace.
Maybe someone would already be contacting the clan members of King Lu in an attempt to overthrow the mother and daughter.
Song Anxu's road to inheriting the throne was indeed full of thorns.
"Then according to the wishes of the palace, let the eldest son Song Chenglin inherit the title of king."
Chen Guanlou figured it out.
You can't bring trouble to the palace. Successfully inheriting the title is more important than anything else. As for Song Anxu, I think he can understand it. Who allowed Emperor Jianshi to die too early?
As long as Emperor Jianshi lives until now, Song Anxu will not have any constraints on inheriting the title. The throne would not fall to Emperor Yuanding, and Concubine Jing might have a chance to get her hands on the throne of the Queen Mother.
"Are you sure?" Xie Changling asked with a smile.
Chen Guanlou nodded heavily, "Sure! As long as the title is in the hands of their family, everything else can be compromised."
Xie Changling chuckled softly, "You made a wise decision and did not try to go against His Majesty. Your Majesty can't do anything to me, but you may not be able to do anything to Prince Lu's Mansion. I will ask for some dignity for Song An in front of Your Majesty. If you can't inherit the title, you still have to have the status you deserve."
"What identity?" Chen Guanlou asked casually. After losing the title of king, Song Anxu would not be satisfied with any other status.
"What is the status of the princess?"
"She was originally the princess. Later, when she became the daughter of the royal family, people forgot about her identity as the princess."
"This is the only thing the court can give. If you don't care about it, forget it." Xie Changling sneered.
